name: FLAG_TEMP_E
desc: When set, follower pokemon won't be spawned

name: FLAG_GARBAGEFLAG
desc: used to store calls of removed flags

name: FLAG_HIDE_CONTEST_POKE_BALL
desc: Always set after new game, object it hides is added directly

name: FLAG_GOOD_LUCK_SAFARI_ZONE
desc: Set after talking to NPC blocking Safari Zone entrance/exit once.

name: FLAG_WHITEOUT_TO_LAVARIDGE
desc: Set after defeating Flannery, so the player cant white out from poison before receiving Go Goggles

name: FLAG_SCOTT_CALL_BATTLE_FRONTIER
desc: Used in order to activate a phone call from Scott, inviting the player to the SS Tidal.

name: FLAG_DEFEATED_MAGMA_SPACE_CENTER
desc: Set when Team Magma is defeated at Mossdeep's Space Center.

name: FLAG_ENABLE_ROXANNE_FIRST_CALL
desc: Set after defeating Brawly. This will activate a call with Roxanne in order to register her.

name: FLAG_ENABLE_FIRST_WALLY_POKENAV_CALL
desc: Set after defeating Wally outside Mauville Gym. Will activate a call later to register Wally.

name: FLAG_SCOTT_CALL_FORTREE_GYM
desc: Triggers call from Scott after defeating Winona

name: FLAG_FAN_CLUB_STRENGTH_SHARED
desc: Set when you rate the strength of another trainer in Lilycove's Trainer Fan Club.

name: FLAG_STEVEN_GUIDES_TO_CAVE_OF_ORIGIN
desc: Set after you follow Steven to the entrance of the Cave of Origin.

name: FLAG_WALLACE_GOES_TO_SKY_PILLAR
desc: Set after speaking to Wallace within the Cave of Origin.

name: FLAG_WONDER_CARD_UNUSED_1
desc: These Wonder Card flags are referenced but never set

name: FLAG_NIGHT_POKEMON
desc: Set at day to hide nighttime overworld pokemon

name: FLAG_DAY_POKEMON
desc: Set at night to hide daytime overworld pokemon

name: FLAG_LEGENDARY_STORY_CAP
desc: Cap until legendary event (ho oh/lugia) has been seen but before player heads to e4

name: FLAG_ENABLE_RADIO
desc: Completed the Radio Tower quiz; value retained for old saves.

name: FLAG_ITEM_ROUTE2_NUGGET
desc: Unused Flag, leftover from R/S. HM08 is given to the player directly in Emerald

name: FLAG_NO_SLOW_STAIR_MOVEMENT
desc: Used to temporaly remove slow stair movement, as it glitches things

name: FLAG_SYS_CAVE_SHIP
desc: Unused Flag, leftover from R/S debug, presumably used by Emerald's debug too

name: FLAG_IS_CHAMPION
desc: Seems to be related to linking.

name: FLAG_GOLDEN_COLOSSEUM
desc: Permission to enter goldenrod underground colosseum

name: FLAG_NEVER_TURNED_OFF_HARD
desc: If player never chose normal mode during important battles

name: FLAG_HIDE_MAREANIES
desc: Hacky workaround for sequence skip with goldenrod shore

name: FLAG_SAFE_FOLLOWER_MOVEMENT
desc: When set, applymovement does not put the follower inside a pokeball
